label: Seed colour
help: The colour the whole palette grows from - defaults to the design system primary.

label: Harmony
help: How the accent hues rotate around the seed.

label: Ramp steps
help: Tones per ramp, dark to light.

label: Include neutrals
help: Adds a seed-tinted grey ramp for text and surfaces.

label: Ramp mode
help: Perceptual grows each ramp as even OKLab tones. Contrast solves every step to a target APCA readability level against the background.

label: Background
help: The surface the palette sits on. In Contrast mode every step is solved for readability against it - defaults to the design system surface (white in a neutral one).

label: Contrast curve
help: How the target APCA Lc is spread across the ramp in Contrast mode.

label: Custom Lc targets
help: Optional comma list of APCA Lc targets, one per step (e.g. 15,30,45,60,75,90). Overrides the curve when set.

label: CSS export style
help: How the CSS download is shaped. Variables emit :root custom properties; Classes emit bg/text/border utility classes. Only affects the CSS export.

label: Colour vision
help: Repaints the whole sheet as another viewer sees it. Every label keeps the real hex, and the reported ratios still describe the actual palette.

label: Contrast grid
help: Adds a matrix under the ramps: every base colour as text on every base colour as a background, with its WCAG ratio and level.
